formal_statement: ¬ (∃ L : Submodule ℂ (Fin 4 × Fin 5 → ℂ), (∀ t ∈ L, (∑ f : Fin 4 ↪ Fin 5, ∏ i, (1 + t (i, f i))) = 120) ∧ Module.finrank ℂ L = 7)
plain_statement: There is no linear space L of 4 x 5 complex matrices of dimension exactly 7 such that, for every t in L, the sum over all injections f of the 4 rows into the 5 columns of the product over rows i of (1 + t(i, f(i))) equals 120, its value at t = 0. Equivalently, no 7-dimensional space on which all sums of k x k subpermanents of t, k = 1 to 4, vanish. This is the negation of the search for such a space. Conjecture.
title: No linear space of 4 x 5 complex matrices of dimension 7 keeps the sum over row-to-column injections of the product of (1 + entry) equal to 120
